reviewNotice: The semantic basis is the author-corrected v5 TeX manuscript identified by filename and SHA-256; it is not redistributed in the Review Kit. Theorem 1.1 has a checked proof, not merely a proposition encoding. The complete n >= 1 local-field implication underlying Theorem 1.5 is proved, including its unary branch. The global deduction in Theorem 1.5, Lemma 8.1, Proposition 8.2, and Theorems 1.7 and 1.9 have conditional proof endpoints over explicit arithmetic proof-data packages; Proposition 8.2 is now derived from lower positive-definite globalization, localization, and equivalence-transport laws rather than assumed as a final field. Concrete number-field localization, scalar-extension, discriminant, and strong-approximation instances remain excluded. The unrestricted odd statement of v5 Corollary 6.3 is false: a kernel-checked e=2, n=3 counterexample proves nonisometry to the diagonal lattice with the same six coefficients. Lemma 8.3 and Theorem 1.8 are therefore exported only for n >= 2 even; no unrestricted odd Lean endpoint remains without a replacement proof. The author-corrected v5 Lemma 7.1 is formalized, and the literal even- and odd-rank families both satisfy the testing equivalence and row-by-row deletion minimality required by Theorem 1.3. The obsolete broader publisher Lemma 7.1(ii) remains refuted for e > 1 and is retained only as a comparison-source regression check. Every literal table model is proved classic-maximal, but no theorem classifies all classic-maximal lattices by those rows. Grade D records a false statement in the authoritative v5 source as well as incomplete whole-paper coverage; concrete global instances, exact clean-release verification, and human semantic sign-off remain outside the present completion claim.
